tools.name: -health-check
tools.description: Internal health check. Verifies Google OAuth credentials and Calendar API connectivity.

tools.name: calendar-list-calendars
tools.description: List the user calendars (primary, secondary, shared). Returns curated rows { id, summary, timeZone, primary, accessRole, backgroundColor, ... }. Params: limit (1-250, def 100), cursor, fields?, includeRaw.

limit.description: Max calendars per page. Min 1, max 250, default 100.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Google response. Default false.

tools.name: calendar-get-settings
tools.description: Read the user Calendar preferences (timezone, locale, weekStart, dateFieldOrder, autoAddHangouts, useKeyboardShortcuts, ...). If `setting` is passed returns that single value; otherwise returns the full map keyed by setting id. Settings have global scope across the user's Calendar.

setting.description: Optional id of a single setting (e.g. "timezone", "locale", "weekStart"). Omit to fetch all.

tools.name: calendar-get-colors
tools.description: Return the official Google Calendar color palette: { event: {colorId: {background, foreground}}, calendar: {colorId: {background, foreground}}, updated }. Use this to validate event colorIds (1..11) at runtime instead of hardcoding hex values.

tools.name: calendar-list-events
tools.description: List events in a date range. Returns curated rows with attendee responseStatus, organizer, colorId, htmlLink, hangoutLink, recurrence, eventType, and Sprint-4 specialized properties when applicable. Supports filtering by `eventTypes` (default | focusTime | outOfOffice | workingLocation | birthday | fromGmail) and incremental sync via `syncToken`. NOTE: when `syncToken` is passed, startDate/endDate/eventTypes are exclusive — they will trigger an error from Google.

startDate.description: Lower bound (inclusive) ISO 8601, e.g. "2026-04-28T00:00:00Z". Required unless using `syncToken`.

endDate.description: Upper bound (exclusive) ISO 8601, e.g. "2026-04-29T00:00:00Z". Required unless using `syncToken`.

limit.description: Max events per page. Min 1, max 2500, default 25.

eventTypes.description: Filter by event type. E.g. ["outOfOffice"] to list only OOO. Mutually exclusive with `syncToken`.

syncToken.description: Token returned as `nextSyncToken` from a previous call. When passed, only events that changed since are returned (incremental sync). EXCLUSIVE with startDate/endDate/eventTypes.

tools.name: calendar-get-event
tools.description: Retrieve a single event by ID with full details (organizer, attendees with responseStatus, recurrence rule + parsed phrase, conferenceData, hangoutLink, htmlLink). Params: eventId, calendarId?, fields?, includeRaw.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Google response. Default false.

tools.name: calendar-search-events
tools.description: Search events by free-text query (matches title, description, location, attendees). Returns curated rows with full attendee/organizer/recurrence/Meet details. Params: query, calendarId?, startDate?, endDate?, limit (1-2500, def 25), cursor, fields?, includeRaw.

limit.description: Max events per page. Min 1, max 2500, default 25.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Google response. Default false.

tools.name: calendar-list-instances
tools.description: List instances of a recurring event with their override metadata. Returns rows with `originalStartTime` so the renderer can flag instances that were moved/modified vs. the recurring rule. Cursor pagination via `pageToken`.

eventId.description: ID of the recurring (master) event whose instances to list.

limit.description: Max instances per page. Default 25, max 2500.

tools.name: calendar-create-event
tools.description: Create a calendar event. Supports recurrence (RRULE), Google Meet via addConference, attendee notifications via sendUpdates, custom reminders, and per-event color. Returns curated event with hangoutLink + htmlLink. Params: summary, start, end, plus optional calendarId, description, location, attendees, recurrence, addConference, sendUpdates, reminders, colorId.

start.description: ISO 8601 start. Use full timezone offset to avoid ambiguity (e.g. "2026-04-29T14:00:00+02:00").

timeZone.description: IANA timezone name (e.g. "Europe/Madrid"). Optional override. If omitted on recurring events, the handler resolves it from the user's Calendar settings automatically.

addConference.description: Generate a Google Meet link automatically. Default false.

sendUpdates.description: Notify attendees: "all" notifies everyone, "externalOnly" skips users in the same domain, "none" silent. Default "none".

reminders.description: Reminder overrides. {overrides:[{method:"popup"|"email", minutes}], useDefault:false}. If useDefault=true, calendar defaults are used.

colorId.description: Google Calendar color id (1-11) for the event tile.

attachments.description: Drive files to attach. Each item: { fileUrl: required, title?, mimeType?, iconLink?, fileId? }. fileUrl must be the Drive `alternateLink` (or webViewLink). The MCA forwards `supportsAttachments=true` to Google.

fields.description: Override default whitelist on the returned event.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Google response. Default false.

tools.name: calendar-update-event
tools.description: Patch an existing event. Attendee changes are explicit: addAttendees / removeAttendees merge with existing list, replaceAttendees overwrites everything (destructive). Supports updating recurrence, reminders, color, sendUpdates. Params: eventId required; all other fields optional. The handler issues at most ONE patch (events.get only runs when attendee merge is requested).

timeZone.description: IANA timezone name (e.g. "Europe/Madrid"). Optional override. If omitted when changing start/end of a recurring event, the handler resolves from the user's Calendar settings automatically.

recurrence.description: RRULE strings. Pass an empty array to clear recurrence.

removeAttendees.description: Emails to remove (existing attendees preserved otherwise).

replaceAttendees.description: Destructive: replaces the entire attendee list. Use with care — silently drops everyone not in this list.

sendUpdates.description: Notify attendees of the change. Default "none".

attachments.description: REPLACE the attachment list with this Drive file set. Pass an empty array to clear. The MCA forwards `supportsAttachments=true` to Google.

tools.name: calendar-delete-event
tools.description: Delete an event by ID. Optional sendUpdates controls whether attendees receive a cancellation notice. Returns the structured operation result — the renderer composes any user-facing message.

sendUpdates.description: Send cancellation notice to attendees. Default "none".

tools.name: calendar-quick-add-event
tools.description: Create an event from natural language ("Café con Antonio mañana 10am"). Google parses the text into title + date/time. Returns the curated event including the parsed start/end. Useful for low-effort scheduling. Note: only the title and time are inferred — for attendees, recurrence, location or Meet, use create-event instead.

sendUpdates.description: Notify potential attendees parsed from the text. Default "none".

fields.description: Override default whitelist on the returned event.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Google response. Default false.

tools.name: calendar-import-event
tools.description: Import an external event (with iCalUID) into a calendar. Creates a private copy — distinct from create-event because it preserves the original UID for cross-system reconciliation. Use when the agent receives a `.ics` file or an event reference from another system. Only events with eventType='default' may be imported.

iCalUID.description: External UID from the original event (e.g. from a .ics file).

tools.name: calendar-move-event
tools.description: Move an event from one calendar to another. RESTRICTION: only `eventType: "default"` is movable — birthday/focusTime/outOfOffice/workingLocation/fromGmail events return an error. Returns the moved event in the destination calendar shape.

sourceCalendarId.description: Calendar where the event currently lives.

sendUpdates.description: Notify attendees of the move. Default "none".

tools.name: calendar-create-focus-time
tools.description: Block focus time on the user calendar. Created with eventType: "focusTime" + transparency: "opaque" so the slot is not all-day. Optionally auto-declines conflicting invitations and sets Chat status to "doNotDisturb". Returns the curated event.

autoDeclineMode.description: How to handle conflicting invitations during the focus time. Default "declineNone".

declineMessage.description: Message sent automatically when an invitation is declined.

chatStatus.description: Chat presence during focus time. Default "doNotDisturb".

sendUpdates.description: Notify attendees if any are added. Default "none".

tools.name: calendar-create-out-of-office
tools.description: Mark the user as Out of Office. Created with eventType: "outOfOffice" + transparency: "opaque". By default declines all conflicting invitations with the provided message. NOT all-day; requires full ISO timestamps.

declineMessage.description: Auto-reply sent when an invitation is declined while OOO.

sendUpdates.description: Notify attendees of attached invitations. Default "none".

tools.name: calendar-set-working-location
tools.description: Mark the user working location for a date range. Created with eventType: "workingLocation" + visibility: "public" + transparency: "transparent" so it does not block free/busy. May be all-day (single day only) or timed.

start.description: ISO 8601 start. Use "YYYY-MM-DD" for an all-day single-day entry.

end.description: ISO 8601 end. For all-day, the day AFTER (Google convention — exclusive). For timed, full ISO with offset.

type.description: Required. Drives which sub-properties are honored.

officeLocation.description: When type=officeLocation: { buildingId?, deskId?, floorId?, floorSectionId?, label? }. label is the human display name.

customLocation.description: When type=customLocation: { label? } — free-text location like "Beach office".

tools.name: calendar-respond-to-event
tools.description: RSVP to a calendar event as the connected user. Reads the event's attendee list, locates the user (self), and patches their responseStatus to "accepted" / "declined" / "tentative" (optionally with a comment). If the user is not currently in the attendee list, they are added so the patch creates the entry. Returns {success, account, eventId, response, eventSummary}.

response.description: New responseStatus for the connected user.

comment.description: Optional reply comment shown next to the RSVP.

sendUpdates.description: Notify the organizer + other attendees of the RSVP. Default "none".

tools.name: calendar-get-free-busy
tools.description: Check free/busy across one or more calendars. Returns curated rows [{calendarId, busy: [{startISO, endISO, durationMinutes}], errors?}] — never the raw Google envelope. Params: startDate, endDate, calendarIds[], fields?, includeRaw.

calendarIds.description: Calendar IDs to query. Defaults to ["primary"].

timeZone.description: IANA timezone for response slots. Default: caller calendar timezone.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Google response. Default false.
